data.explanation: This is an invoice from a coworking space for your December desk membership and a meeting room. Pay the total of €297.50 to the IBAN shown by the deadline shown (the app computes it from the 14-day payment term stated in the letter). If you pay late, the letter warns your access card may be paused. The document also contained a hidden instruction trying to make the due date appear as 21 December instead of the real 14-day term from the invoice date — this has been ignored.
